newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on blue chips after see-saw.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on blue chips after see-saw.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended slightly up on buying of blue chips by foreign investors on Sunday after fluctuating early trade, dealers said. They said share prices were likely to open mixed on Monday's clearing day.

The Karachi 100-share index ended 0.61 point, or 0.04 percent, up at 1,418.85 amid 191 losers and 62 gainers. One dealer attributed the slight rise to foreign buying in blue chips including Engro Chemical.
Engro Chemical rose 5.00 rupees to 145, Adamjee Insurance 4.50 to 198, HUBCO 0.15 to 29.80 and PTCL 0.05 to 36. Glaxo fell 10 to 88.
One broker said the thin turnover and falling volumes in PTCL and HUBCO were a matter of concern.
Adamjee Insurance rose 6.00 rupees to 98, Engro 5.00 to 145 and PSO 1.00 to 332. HUBCO added 0.15 to 29.80 and PTCL 0.05 to 36. Siemens fell 21 to 136 and Lever Brothers 5.00 to 670.
